summary: A packaged first-principles compiler base for deterministic HyperFrames-native support structure when no production design template is eligible. It is not a promoted design template and does not replace the required ordinary primary material.
hard_rules: Compile only deterministic HTML, CSS and SVG support structure from validated brief semantics and frozen whole-film rules.
Never replace, hide or reduce the approved ordinary primary material to wallpaper.
Never fabricate facts, interfaces, logos, evidence, subtitles or decorative particle fields.
Preserve protected user-design layers; native support may fill only unspecified auxiliary relationships.
Every action must produce a visible semantic result, stop for the readable hold and remain seek-safe.

adaptation_knobs.purpose: Choose how the native support surface relates to the approved ordinary primary without becoming an ungrounded skin.
constraints: The selected state must preserve the primary material's visible contribution.
A fully opaque field is allowed only when the approved design and compositing mode require it.

adaptation_knobs.purpose: Freeze one content-driven reading path and owned negative-space responsibility.
constraints: Every state must identify one first-read anchor and an ordered reading path.
Do not use a three-card dashboard or centered title card as a generic fallback.

adaptation_knobs.purpose: Bind the visual carrier to the validated representation mode rather than a decorative motif.
constraints: Documentary evidence requires registered literal evidence.
The anchor must make the narrated relationship or result guessable without subtitles.

adaptation_knobs.purpose: Limit real local typography to the factual role required by the selected anchor and result.
constraints: All factual text remains real HTML or SVG text from approved copy.
No remote, system or generic font fallback is permitted.

adaptation_knobs.purpose: Select a traceable color relationship without introducing a default aesthetic.
constraints: User, brand and approved-material evidence takes priority.
Do not introduce a default purple-blue gradient or unrelated neon accent.

adaptation_knobs.purpose: Choose the one auxiliary job performed by native graphics around the approved primary material.
constraints: The support role must be declared by the approved design slice.
Native support cannot become the Flat Shot Kit primary asset or primary consumer.

adaptation_knobs.purpose: Bind one deterministic action verb to a visible state change and stable result.
constraints: Use at most one primary action cause per shot.
Complete the action before the content-dependent reading hold.
